mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.0% in the prior month, it signals a tightening cycle that increases equity discount rates and depresses valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS > 2.0%, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and decline in unemployment rate signals a strong economy with tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to higher discount rates and growth concerns.
regime_hint: tightening cycle with strong labor market
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with rising FEDFUNDS and falling UNRATE, or interaction term coefficient is positive with p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime defined by high housing starts and strong consumer credit, the S&P 500 underperforms as economic overheating increases recession risks, generating negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with high HOUST and RSAFS, or Rank IC for regime is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in the unemployment rate over the prior 3 months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending expectations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with rising UNRATE, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% in the prior month, it signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer confidence and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances with UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC is negative over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and rise in consumer credit (RSAFS) signals weakening demand, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with falling HOUST and rising RSAFS, or interaction term coefficient is positive with p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained regime defined by declining industrial production, manufacturing slowdowns reduce corporate earnings growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with INDPRO < 95.0, or Rank IC for regime is below 0.03.
